thesis_driver.series: Government take paid on Brazilian oil and gas production (royalties plus special participation)
thesis_driver.unit: percent of field gross/net revenue (10-15% royalties; 0-40% special participation)
thesis_driver.why: The ANP's September 2025 reference-price methodology change "in general, increased the amounts of government take collected in Brazil", and royalties of 10-15% of gross field revenue plus special participation of up to 40% of net revenue determine how much of Petrobras's production revenue it retains.
